title: Cardinal Clipart, 12 Winter Songbirds PNG and SVG, Chickadee, Robin, Blue Jay, Bluebird and Owl, Christmas Bird Sublimation Designs
description:
Twelve winter songbird clipart designs for Christmas: red cardinals on holly, in flight and in a cozy knitted hat, a black-capped chickadee, a robin, a wren on a pine cone, a little owl in a scarf, a blue jay, a bluebird on winterberries, a birdhouse, a holly sprig and a pine cone sprig. Each one comes as a full-color PNG with a transparent background at 300 dpi, plus a one-color SVG line-art version of the same design.

Use them for Christmas tees and sweatshirts, sublimation mugs and tumblers, tote bags, cards, gift tags, stickers, invitations and winter crafts. The designs are drawn in a warm flat style with clean dark outlines, so they stay crisp on light and dark backgrounds.

THE 12 DESIGNS
1 Cardinal on holly · 2 Chickadee on pine · 3 Robin with berries · 4 Winter wren · 5 Little owl · 6 Blue jay · 7 Bluebird on berries · 8 Flying cardinal · 9 Birdhouse · 10 Holly sprig · 11 Pine cone sprig · 12 Cardinal in a hat

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 12 PNG files, transparent background, 300 dpi, 3600 px on the longest side (12 in), ready for sublimation, print and print-then-cut
• 12 SVG files: the same designs as single-layer, one-color line art that scales to any size
• One ZIP download with a README and the license

GOOD TO KNOW
• The SVGs are line-art versions for one-color printing, recoloring and crafts, not vinyl cut files: some lines are fine
• There is no text on the designs
• All designs are original, drawn in a stylized clipart look rather than as field-guide bird illustrations
• The tee, card and tote in the photos show the designs in use; you receive the digital files only
• Colors vary a little between screens, printers and blanks

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on physical items you make and sell (tees, mugs, tumblers, totes, cards, stickers), up to 500 items per design. Please don't resell, share or upload the digital files, use them on print-on-demand marketplaces, or include them in other digital products.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
